quarantine.note: restore lands in a quarantine, never over the live workspace; new publishing stays frozen until the independent verification closes

oldWriterFence.note: an old writer is fenced only by process-level evidence (real termination method plus a gone confirmation checked against the live pid); re-registering a shared directory is a masquerade, not fencing

permissionReconciliation.note: restored ACL snapshots and membership are data; nothing is replayed and nobody is readmitted by the restore itself — permissions are re-authenticated against the current authority, and receipts from superseded epochs stay excluded from current state

release.note: release happens only after the restored quarantine is verified to carry the same run/operation identity with an independent byte-level readback

authorityTransfer.note: when the original Runner is permanently lost, a controlled transfer approval plus old-writer isolation evidence registers the new authority (epoch bump, same run); a shared directory must never masquerade as distributed fencing
